losses: This interface cannot determine physical battery failure, consumer compliance, refund completion, regulator orders, carrier restrictions, court outcomes or independent findings.
mappings.rationale: P_1 persists across all nine episodes, but the model does not expose its later knowledge early. It is one organizational decision interface; internal engineering, regional subsidiaries, executives and legal teams are not separately observable source participants.

losses: No SDI statement, remediation choice, private knowledge or admission of defect is invented.
mappings.rationale: P_2 is preserved as the named first-battery supplier and later investigation subject. All three actor-local rows describe supply or passive subject status rather than an exposed supplier-authored decision.

losses: Recall eligibility is not population-wide return, refund, exchange, injury or verified incident prevalence.
mappings.rationale: P_3's two names describe the same global purchaser cohort before and after recall eligibility. The Population preserves aggregate reporting without inventing individual devices or unanimous behavior.

losses: No general enforcement regime, fine, finding of defect, nationwide full-recall order or completed compliance is modeled.
mappings.rationale: P_4 represents the Draft's named national product-quality regulator for one bounded requirement. It does not absorb civil-aviation, court, media or consumer authority.

losses: No completed return, payment, replacement delivery, participation rate or individual consumer trajectory is represented.
mappings.rationale: The Draft exposes eligibility and an explicit refund-or-replacement option rather than observed uptake. The Population therefore records a constructed request choice and labels it as such; it does not claim that all 1,858 owners acted.

losses: The statement neither establishes root cause nor proves battery safety; no supplier production, testing or remediation policy is simulated.
mappings.rationale: P_6 retains ATL's one exposed public statement. Its later appearance as investigation subject is passive and does not grant access to private manufacturing knowledge.

losses: The Population does not establish physical cause, injury, damages, judicial acceptance, case outcome, recall participation or public-opinion prevalence.
mappings.rationale: P_7 consolidates the same regular-purchaser cohort across incident, full-recall and litigation appearances. Separate fields preserve reporting, public disagreement and legal filing; no individual claimant is synthesized.

losses: It cannot cause the fire, determine battery defect, issue a government flight restriction, suspend Samsung production or represent all airlines.
mappings.rationale: The Draft describes P_8 as experiencing an aircraft fire rather than choosing the physical event. This Agent is explicitly a representation gate: it owns only the decision to create the modeled incident record/message.

losses: No raw test data, defect probability, supplier liability allocation or guarantee of independence is modeled.
mappings.rationale: P_9 is a disclosed composite because the Draft presents three institutions as one organization group. It owns only the shared investigation records exposed by the source, not unobserved disagreements or laboratory microprocesses.
